```python
class Solution:
    def maxChunksToSorted(self, arr: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(arr)
        arr.sort()
        chunks = 0
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            j = i
            while j < n and arr[j] == arr[i]:
                j += 1
            chunks += 1
            i = j
        return chunks
```
